overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by posting an April 4 notice that listed committee appointments without naming the candidates, but ordered no further remedy because the Board reposted and reaffirmed the appointments on April 18.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the April 4 notice listing appointments to the Mindess School Building Committee lacked sufficient detail by not naming the candidates.
allegations.key_passage: Because the notice did not include these specific details about each appointment, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law.
